CREATE       VIEW silver.master_src_rpt as
SELECT 
    COALESCE(r.[report_name], s.[report_name])             AS [report_name],
   -- COALESCE(r.[accounting_period], s.[accounting_period])
    '09/30/2026' AS [accounting_period],
    COALESCE(r.[lob], s.[lob])                             AS [lob],
    COALESCE(r.[jurisdiction], s.[jurisdiction])           AS [jurisdiction],
 
    COALESCE(s.[total_claims], 0)                          AS [src_total_claims],
    COALESCE(r.[total_claims], 0)                          AS [rpt_total_claims],
    COALESCE(s.[total_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    
    COALESCE(s.[total_approved_payment_amt], 0.00)         AS [src_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_approved_payment_amt], 0.00)         AS [rpt_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(s.[total_access_fee], 0.00)                   AS [src_access_fee],
    COALESCE(r.[total_access_fee], 0.00)                   AS [rpt_access_fee],
    COALESCE(s.[total_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)               AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)               AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(s.[total_admin_amt], 0.00)                    AS [src_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_admin_amt], 0.00)                    AS [rpt_admin_amt]
FROM [silver].[master_rpt] r
INNER JOIN [silver].[master_src] s
    ON r.report_name=s.report_name
	AND r.[accounting_period] = s.[accounting_period]
   AND r.[lob]               = s.[lob]
   AND r.[jurisdiction]      = s.[jurisdiction]
GO

CREATE   VIEW silver.misc_src_bucketA AS

WITH BucketA AS (
    -- Universe of all claims active or reported during the period
    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[opening_claims_src]
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[new_added_claims_src]
),
ClosedSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[closed_claims_src]
),
PurgedSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[deleted_purged_claims_src]
),
GLEndingSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[gl_reported_ending_src]
)
SELECT 
    'misc_src_bucketA'                              AS [report_name],
    a.[accounting_period]                           AS [accounting_period],
    a.[lob]                                         AS [lob],
    a.[jurisdiction]                                AS [jurisdiction],
    COUNT(a.[claim_id])                            AS [total_claims],
    COALESCE(SUM(a.[approved_payment_amt]), 0.00)   AS [total_approved_payment_amt],
    COALESCE(SUM(a.[access_fee]), 0.00)             AS [total_access_fee],
    COALESCE(SUM(a.[claim_liab_amt]), 0.00)         AS [total_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(SUM(a.[admin_amt]), 0.00)              AS [total_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(SUM(a.[net_liab_amt]), 0.00)           AS [total_net_liab_amt]

FROM BucketA a
LEFT JOIN ClosedSet   c ON a.[claim_id] = c.[claim_id]
LEFT JOIN PurgedSet   p ON a.[claim_id] = p.[claim_id]
LEFT JOIN GLEndingSet g ON a.[claim_id] = g.[claim_id]

-- Filters only for claims present in Bucket A but missing from Bucket B
WHERE c.[claim_id] IS NULL 
  AND p.[claim_id] IS NULL 
  AND g.[claim_id] IS NULL

GROUP BY 
    a.[accounting_period],
    a.[lob],
    a.[jurisdiction];

GO

CREATE   VIEW silver.misc_src_bucketB AS

WITH BucketB AS (
    -- Universe of all resolved, derecognized, or ending GL ledger claims
    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[closed_claims_src]
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[deleted_purged_claims_src]
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        [claim_id],
        [policy_no],
        [lob],
        [jurisdiction],
        [accounting_period],
        [approved_payment_amt],
        [access_fee],
        [claim_liab_amt],
        [admin_amt],
        [net_liab_amt]
    FROM [bronze].[gl_reported_ending_src]
),
OpeningSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[opening_claims_src]
),
NewAddedSet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT [claim_id] FROM [bronze].[new_added_claims_src]
)
SELECT 
    'misc_src_bucketB'                              AS [report_name],
    b.[accounting_period]                           AS [accounting_period],
    b.[lob]                                         AS [lob],
    b.[jurisdiction]                                AS [jurisdiction],
    COUNT(b.[claim_id])                            AS [total_claims],
    COALESCE(SUM(b.[approved_payment_amt]), 0.00)   AS [total_approved_payment_amt],
    COALESCE(SUM(b.[access_fee]), 0.00)             AS [total_access_fee],
    COALESCE(SUM(b.[claim_liab_amt]), 0.00)         AS [total_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(SUM(b.[admin_amt]), 0.00)              AS [total_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(SUM(b.[net_liab_amt]), 0.00)           AS [total_net_liab_amt]

FROM BucketB b
LEFT JOIN OpeningSet  o ON b.[claim_id] = o.[claim_id]
LEFT JOIN NewAddedSet n ON b.[claim_id] = n.[claim_id]

-- Filters exclusively for records in Bucket B that have NO parent in Bucket A:
WHERE o.[claim_id] IS NULL 
  AND n.[claim_id] IS NULL

GROUP BY 
    b.[accounting_period],
    b.[lob],
    b.[jurisdiction];

GO

CREATE       VIEW [silver].[misc_bucketA_src_rpt]
AS
SELECT 
    -- 1. Dimensions (Consolidated via COALESCE)
    'misc_bucketA'                                         AS [report_name],
    COALESCE(r.[accounting_period], s.[accounting_period]) AS [accounting_period],
    COALESCE(r.[lob], s.[lob])                             AS [lob],
    COALESCE(r.[jurisdiction], s.[jurisdiction])           AS [jurisdiction],
    -- 2. Claim Counts (Source vs Report)
    COALESCE(s.[total_claims], 0)                          AS [src_total_claims],
    COALESCE(r.[total_claims], 0)                          AS [rpt_total_claims],
    -- 3. Net Liability (Total Reserve Balance)
    COALESCE(s.[total_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_net_liab_amt], 0.00)                 AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    -- 4. Component Breakdown Amounts
    COALESCE(s.[total_approved_payment_amt], 0.00)         AS [src_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_approved_payment_amt], 0.00)         AS [rpt_approved_amt],
    COALESCE(s.[total_access_fee], 0.00)                   AS [src_access_fee],
    COALESCE(r.[total_access_fee], 0.00)                   AS [rpt_access_fee],
    COALESCE(s.[total_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)               AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_claim_liab_amt], 0.00)               AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    COALESCE(s.[total_admin_amt], 0.00)                    AS [src_admin_amt],
    COALESCE(r.[total_admin_amt], 0.00)                    AS [rpt_admin_amt]
  
FROM [silver].[misc_rpt_bucketA] r
JOIN [silver].[misc_src_bucketA] s
    ON r.[accounting_period] = s.[accounting_period]
    AND r.report_name=s.report_name
   AND r.[lob]               = s.[lob]
   AND r.[jurisdiction]      = s.[jurisdiction]
GO

-- 1. Original master_src_rpt rows (IH5P, IH2, IH7, IH3, IH5C, misc buckets)

CREATE         view silver.open_balance_cal AS
SELECT 
    [report_name],
    [accounting_period],
    [lob],
    [jurisdiction],
    [src_total_claims],
    [rpt_total_claims],
    [src_net_liab_amt],
    [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    [src_approved_amt],
    [rpt_approved_amt],
    [src_access_fee],
    [rpt_access_fee],
    [src_claim_liab_amt],
    [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    [src_admin_amt],
    [rpt_admin_amt]
FROM [silver].[master_src_rpt]

UNION ALL 
SELECT * FROM 
[silver].[misc_bucketA_src_rpt]

UNION ALL 

SELECT * FROM 
[silver].[misc_bucketB_src_rpt]

UNION ALL
SELECT 
  
    'open_balance_cal'                                 AS [report_name],
    [accounting_period],
    [lob],
    [jurisdiction],
    
    -- Total Claims (src & rpt)
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_total_claims],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_total_claims],

    -- Net Liability Amounts (src & rpt)
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],

    -- Approved Indemnity Amounts
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_approved_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_approved_amt],

    -- Access Fee / Deductibles
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_access_fee],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_access_fee],

    -- Claim Loss Liability
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],

    -- Administrative Expenses (ALAE)
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [src_admin_amt],
    
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5P'                 THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH2'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) - (
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH7'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH3'                  THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END) +
        SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt' THEN ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS [rpt_admin_amt]

FROM [silver].[master_src_rpt]
WHERE [report_name] IN ('IH5P', 'IH2', 'misc_bucketB_src_rpt', 'IH7', 'IH3', 'misc_bucketA_src_rpt')
GROUP BY [accounting_period], [lob], [jurisdiction]

CREATE   view silver.roll_forwrad_variance AS
SELECT 
    'roll_forwrad_variance'                                                          AS [report_name],
    [accounting_period],
    [lob],
    [jurisdiction],
    -- 1. Claims Count: SUM(IH5C) - SUM(open_balance_cal)
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_total_claims] ELSE 0 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_total_claims] ELSE 0 END) AS [src_total_claims],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_total_claims] ELSE 0 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_total_claims] ELSE 0 END) AS [rpt_total_claims],
    -- 2. Net Liability (Total Reserve): SUM(IH5C) - SUM(open_balance_cal)
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [src_net_liab_amt],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_net_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    -- 3. Approved Payment Amount
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [src_approved_amt],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_approved_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [rpt_approved_amt],
    -- 4. Access Fee (Deductible / Co-pay)
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [src_access_fee],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_access_fee] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [rpt_access_fee],
    -- 5. Claim Liability Amount
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [src_claim_liab_amt],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_claim_liab_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    -- 6. Admin Amount
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [src_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [src_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [src_admin_amt],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'IH5C' THEN [rpt_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN [report_name] = 'open_balance_cal' THEN [rpt_admin_amt] ELSE 0.00 END) AS [rpt_admin_amt]
FROM [silver].[open_balance_cal]
WHERE [report_name] IN ('IH5C', 'open_balance_cal')
GROUP BY 
    [accounting_period],
    [lob],
    [jurisdiction]
GO

CREATE   VIEW silver.src_rpt_var as
SELECT 
    [report_name], 
    [accounting_period], 
    [lob], 
    [jurisdiction], 
    
    -- Claims Comparison & Variance
    [src_total_claims], 
    [rpt_total_claims], 
    ISNULL([rpt_total_claims], 0) - ISNULL([src_total_claims], 0) AS [variance_total_claims], 
    
    -- Net Liability Comparison & Variance
    [src_net_liab_amt], 
    [rpt_net_liab_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_net_liab_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_net_liab_amt], 0) AS [variance_net_liab_amt],
    -- Approved Amount Comparison & Variance
    [src_approved_amt], 
    [rpt_approved_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_approved_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_approved_amt], 0) AS [variance_approved_amt],
    -- Access Fee Comparison & Variance
    [src_access_fee], 
    [rpt_access_fee],
    ISNULL([rpt_access_fee], 0) - ISNULL([src_access_fee], 0) AS [variance_access_fee],
    -- Claim Liability Comparison & Variance
    [src_claim_liab_amt], 
    [rpt_claim_liab_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_claim_liab_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_claim_liab_amt], 0) AS [variance_claim_liab_amt],
    -- Admin Amount Comparison & Variance
    [src_admin_amt], 
    [rpt_admin_amt],
    ISNULL([rpt_admin_amt], 0) - ISNULL([src_admin_amt], 0) AS [variance_admin_amt]
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM [silver].[open_balance_cal]
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT * FROM [silver].[roll_forwrad_variance]
) AS [combined_data];
GO
